findings.title: Missing test for 'check' subcommand when feature is disabled
findings.body: The `testFeatureNotEnabled` test only verifies that the `metadata` subcommand fails when the `rolling-updates` feature is not enabled. The `check` subcommand (`UpdateCompatibilityCheck`) has the same feature gate (line 46 of UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java), but there is no corresponding test verifying it also fails with the expected error message and exit code 4 when the feature is disabled.

findings.title: Breaking change: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE changed from 4 to 3
findings.body: The `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` constant was changed from 4 to 3, and exit code 4 was repurposed for `FEATURE_DISABLED`. Any existing scripts or automation that were already using exit code 4 to detect 'recreate upgrade needed' (as was the case before this PR) will now silently misinterpret the result. While this is a preview feature, the documentation should explicitly call out this exit code change for early adopters, or the old value should be preserved and a different code chosen for FEATURE_DISABLED.

findings.title: testWrongVersions does not assert exit code for incompatible versions
findings.body: The `testWrongVersions` test verifies the error message content but does not assert that the exit code equals `RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE` (3). Given that this PR changes that exit code from 4 to 3, an assertion on the exit code would protect against future regressions and confirm the documented exit code contract.

findings.title: Feature flag not enabled when updateStrategy is null, but test still expects upgrade status condition
findings.body: In `createInitialDeployment`, when `updateStrategy` is null the method returns early without enabling the `rolling-updates` feature. However, `testImageChange` with a null strategy still calls `eventuallyRecreateUpgradeStatus`. If the operator's reconciler requires the feature flag to be enabled to produce any upgrade status condition (as implied by the CAUTION in the docs saying the operator will fail without it), this test case may not be exercising the intended code path or may fail once the operator enforces the feature gate. The relationship between the feature flag and the default (null) strategy behavior should be clarified or tested explicitly.
